description: Provision an Azure Insights MetricAlert via Azure Service Operator. Fields mirror the insights.azure.com/v1api20180301 MetricAlert spec.

actions.description:
Actions: the array of actions that are performed when the alert rule becomes active, and when an alert condition is
resolved.

actionGroupId.description: ActionGroupId: the id of the action group to use.

actionGroupReference.description: ActionGroupReference: the id of the action group to use.

armId.description:
ARMID is a string of the form /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}.
The /resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName} bit is optional as some resources are scoped at the subscription level
ARMID is mutually exclusive with Group, Kind, Namespace and Name.

group.description: Group is the Kubernetes group of the resource.

kind.description: Kind is the Kubernetes kind of the resource.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes name of the resource.

webHookProperties.description:
WebHookProperties: This field allows specifying custom properties, which would be appended to the alert payload sent as
input to the webhook.

autoMitigate.description: AutoMitigate: the flag that indicates whether the alert should be auto resolved or not. The default is true.

azureName.description:
AzureName: The name of the resource in Azure. This is often the same as the name of the resource in Kubernetes but it
doesn't have to be.

credentialFrom.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding the Azure credential to use for this resource. Rendered as the serviceoperator.azure.com/credential-from annotation. Leave empty to inherit the credential from the namespace, then from the operator's global credential. The resource's subscription and resource group come from spec.owner, not from this field.
credentialFrom.title: Azure credential Secret

criteria.description: Criteria: defines the specific alert criteria information.

microsoftAzureMonitorMultipleResourceMul.description: MicrosoftAzureMonitorMultipleResourceMultipleMetric: Mutually exclusive with all other properties

allOf.description: AllOf: the list of multiple metric criteria for this 'all of' operation.

dynamicThresholdCriterion.description: Dynamic: Mutually exclusive with all other properties

alertSensitivity.description:
AlertSensitivity: The extent of deviation required to trigger an alert. This will affect how tight the threshold is to
the metric series pattern.

criterionType.description: CriterionType: Specifies the type of threshold criteria

operator.description: Operator: the dimension operator. Only 'Include' and 'Exclude' are supported

failingPeriods.description:
FailingPeriods: The minimum number of violations required within the selected lookback time window required to raise an
alert.

minFailingPeriodsToAlert.description:
MinFailingPeriodsToAlert: The number of violations to trigger an alert. Should be smaller or equal to
numberOfEvaluationPeriods.

numberOfEvaluationPeriods.description:
NumberOfEvaluationPeriods: The number of aggregated lookback points. The lookback time window is calculated based on the
aggregation granularity (windowSize) and the selected number of aggregated points.

ignoreDataBefore.description:
IgnoreDataBefore: Use this option to set the date from which to start learning the metric historical data and calculate
the dynamic thresholds (in ISO8601 format)

operator.description: Operator: The operator used to compare the metric value against the threshold.

skipMetricValidation.description:
SkipMetricValidation: Allows creating an alert rule on a custom metric that isn't yet emitted, by causing the metric
validation to be skipped.

timeAggregation.description: TimeAggregation: the criteria time aggregation types.

staticThresholdCriterion.description: Static: Mutually exclusive with all other properties

evaluationFrequency.description: EvaluationFrequency: how often the metric alert is evaluated represented in ISO 8601 duration format.

operatorSpec.description:
OperatorSpec: The specification for configuring operator behavior. This field is interpreted by the operator and not
passed directly to Azure

configMapExpressions.description: ConfigMapExpressions: configures where to place operator written dynamic ConfigMaps (created with CEL expressions).

items.description:
DestinationExpression is a CEL expression and a destination to store the result in. The destination may
be a secret or a configmap. The value of the expression is stored at the specified location in
the destination.

annotations.description: Annotations is an optional set of annotations to apply to the destination resource.

key.description:
Key is the key in the ConfigMap or Secret being written to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a string
this is required to identify what key to write to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a map[string]string
Key must not be set, instead the keys written will be determined dynamically based on the keys of the resulting
map[string]string.

labels.description: Labels is an optional set of labels to apply to the destination resource.

name.description:
Name is the name of the Kubernetes configmap or secret to write to.
The configmap or secret will be created in the same namespace as the resource.

value.description:
Value is a CEL expression. The CEL expression may return a string or a map[string]string. For more information
on CEL in ASO see https://azure.github.io/azure-service-operator/guide/expressions/

Owner: The owner of the resource. The owner controls where the resource goes when it is deployed. The owner also
controls the resources lifecycle. When the owner is deleted the resource will also be deleted. Owner is expected to be a
reference to a resources.azure.com/ResourceGroup resource

ScopesReferences: the list of resource id's that this metric alert is scoped to. You cannot change the scope of a metric
rule based on logs.

targetResourceRegion.description:
TargetResourceRegion: the region of the target resource(s) on which the alert is created/updated. Mandatory if the scope
contains a subscription, resource group, or more than one resource.

targetResourceType.description:
TargetResourceType: the resource type of the target resource(s) on which the alert is created/updated. Mandatory if the

windowSize.description:
WindowSize: the period of time (in ISO 8601 duration format) that is used to monitor alert activity based on the
threshold.
